policies.description: Any request to create a record must validate all mandatory fields before proceeding.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: Any request to update a record must validate all mandatory fields before proceeding.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: Every Configuration Item must have a recorded owner_id.
references: CI Owner: All CIs must have a recorded owner_id.

policies.description: The status field of a Configuration Item must be one of the allowed enumeration values: in_use, in_stock, maintenance, retired, or disposed.
When linking a Configuration Item to an active Incident, the CI status must be either in_use or maintenance; linking is prohibited if the status is retired or disposed.
references: CI Status: Only CIs with status = in_use or status = maintenance can be linked to active Incidents. Do not link CIs in status = retired or status = disposed.

policies.policy_name: User Active Status for Ownership Assignment
policies.description: When assigning a user as the owner of a Configuration Item, the user must have users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

policies.description: Any configuration item that is to be created, read, updated, or deleted must reside in the `configuration_item` table; the tool must operate only on records within this table.
references: Table: All IT assets must be recorded in the configuration_item table.
